name: towles-tool-app
description: Bridges Claude Code to the towles-tool desktop app: its loopback-HTTP MCP server for board tasks, the Preview pane and calendar, plus a mod that shows this checkout's task, PR, next meeting and copy offers in a band above the prompt, delivers notes you send the session from the app (read at the agent's next step), adds /park to file an idea as a backlog task and /next to suggest your next prompt, and a hook that nudges the app to refresh PR/issue data after a `gh pr`/`gh issue` mutation. Requires the app to be running.
